rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for shutting a door, taking something out of operation, closing a business, or closing a file or app.

example.english: We’re done for the day; remember to close the air conditioner.
example.traditional: 我哋收工喇，記得關冷氣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sau1 gung1 laa3 gei3 dak1 gwaan1 laang5 hei3

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice specifically for physically shutting a door, window, gate, or similar opening.

example.english: Remember to close the door firmly when you go out.
example.jyutping: ceot1 mun4 hau2 gei3 dak1 saan1 sat6 dou6 mun4

rows.note: Use 近 as the all-purpose adjective for small physical or time distance.

example.english: This shop is close to the MTR station.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 lei4 dei6 tit3 zaam6 hou2 gan6

rows.note: Use 差唔多 when something is almost right or nearly equal, not for physical distance.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 caa1 m4 do1 zou6 jyun4 laa3

rows.note: Use 親密 for an intimate personal relationship such as a close friendship.

example.english: I’m close friends with Ah Yan.
example.traditional: 我同阿欣係好親密嘅朋友。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 jan1 hai6 hou2 can1 mat6 ge3 pang4 jau5

rows.note: Use 仔細 when close means careful, attentive, or detailed in examining something.

example.english: You need to take a close look at the contract.
example.traditional: 你要仔細睇清楚份合約。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 zai2 sai3 tai2 cing1 co2 fan6 hap6 joek3

rows.note: Use this when a meeting, session, event, or other activity is being brought to an end.

example.english: The lecture will close at five.
example.jyutping: go3 gong2 zo6 ng5 dim2 zau6 git3 cuk1

rows.note: Use this for blocking or closing off a road, entrance, area, or other passage.

example.english: The road ahead is being repaired, so they had to close it off.
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 sau1 lou6 tiu4 lou6 fung1 zo2
